statement: In 3 of 7 books a toy or animal companion is drawn mirroring the protagonist's feeling while saying nothing in the text; the other 4 have no such silent companion.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2025)

analyst_note: 2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Neither new book has a silent mirroring companion (Best Friends' companion speaks; the wordless book has none).

magicpaper.current: catalog companions speak and act in text
magicpaper.suggested: Hypothesis: a companion can amplify feeling silently, through the picture; relevant to companion illustration briefs.
magicpaper.note: Companions as emotional amplifiers, not protagonists.
